Create an ORIGINAL game building sprite for a small radar station in a hard-scrabble frontier colony: a squat steel equipment shed with a short lattice mast rising from its middle. Image 1 is our approved radio building from the same game: match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy its shape.

Draw the station WITHOUT its rotating antenna: the antenna is drawn separately and turns over the mast. Show the mast's top as a small round turntable plate in the exact centre of the canvas, left empty.

Square canvas. The building fills the canvas with a small even margin on a plain pure white background. Its roof plan: a square shed roof of ribbed grey steel panels; the lattice mast's square top in the centre with the round turntable plate on it; a small cable tray running from the mast to one edge; a short ventilation box and a door hatch near one corner; four concrete footing pads at the corners.

Style: a top-down sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, muted industrial greys with one faded safety-orange accent, rounded corners, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No antenna, dish, people, animals, text, letters, numbers, logos, dials, screens or lamps. No floor, ground, grass, shadow outside the building, perspective, tilt or visible side faces. Top surfaces only.
